summary: Single selection with a button and a list in a popover, with rich options (descriptions, icons, sections) and built-in validation.
whenToUse: When you need consistent styling across browsers.
whenNotToUse: Many options or search: use Combobox.
Forms that must work without JavaScript: use NativeSelect.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Text shown when nothing is selected.

props.name: startAdornment
props.description: Icon at the start of the trigger.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Content when there are no options.

props.name: isRequired / isInvalid / isDisabled
props.description: Field states; with name, the value is submitted with the form.

props.name: triggerRef
props.description: Ref to the button (the component is generic, so it doesn’t use forwardRef).

inherits: Props of the react-aria-components Select (name, isOpen, onOpenChange, validate…).

keyboard.action: Selects and closes; focus returns to the button.

accessibility: APG “Select-only combobox” pattern; label, description, and error are linked.
A hidden <select> takes part in form submission and autofill.
responsive: The popover matches the trigger width and stays within the viewport.
customization: Same field anatomy as TextField; classes via className and popoverProps.className.
commonMistakes: Using it for immediate actions: use DropdownMenu.
Passing items to the ListBox instead of the Select.
